# Sberbank
> Russia’s largest bank offering retail and business banking, payments, investments, insurance, and digital services.

Sberbank provides financial products for individuals, small businesses, and corporations, alongside online banking, cards, loans, mortgages, deposits, insurance, and ecosystem services. The site includes product information, service guidance, support resources, and business banking materials.

## Retail Banking
- [Cards](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/bank_cards): Overview of debit, credit, and digital cards for individuals.
- [Loans](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/credits): Consumer lending products and borrowing options for retail customers.
- [Mortgages](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/credits/home): Mortgage programs, property financing, and housing loan information.
- [Deposits and Savings](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/contributions): Savings products, deposits, and account options for individuals.
- [Payments and Transfers](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/remittance): Money transfers, bill payments, and related retail payment services.
- [Insurance](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/insurance): Insurance products available to individual customers through Sberbank.
- [Investments](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/investments): Investment and wealth-building products for retail clients.

## Digital Banking
- [SberBank Online](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/dist_services/inner_apps): Digital banking applications and remote service channels for individuals.
- [Mobile App](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/dist_services/inner_apps): Access to mobile banking tools and account management features.
- [Remote Services](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/dist_services): Online and remote banking services for personal customers.
- [Notifications and Security](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/dist_services): Information on secure use of digital banking services.

## Cards and Payments
- [Debit Cards](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/bank_cards/debit): Debit card products, features, and service conditions.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/bank_cards/credit): Credit card offerings, terms, and customer benefits.
- [Card Services](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/bank_cards/service): Card maintenance, limits, and operational services.
- [Transfers](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/remittance): Domestic and other transfer options for individuals.
- [Payments](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/paymentsandremittances): Payment services and transaction categories for retail customers.

## Loans and Financing
- [Consumer Loans](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/credits/money): Cash and consumer loan products for individuals.
- [Refinancing](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/credits/refinancing): Refinancing options for existing credit obligations.
- [Mortgage Loans](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/credits/home): Home financing programs and mortgage product details.
- [Educational Loans](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/credits/education): Education financing products and related borrowing terms.

## Savings and Investments
- [Deposits](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/contributions/deposits): Deposit products with terms and savings conditions.
- [Savings Accounts](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/contributions/savings): Flexible savings account options for individuals.
- [Investments](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/investments): Investment services, brokerage, and wealth products.
- [Pension Solutions](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/pensions): Pension-related financial products and planning options.

## Insurance and Protection
- [Insurance Products](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/insurance): Personal insurance offerings and protection services.
- [Life and Health Insurance](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/insurance): Coverage options for life and health-related risks.
- [Property Insurance](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/insurance): Insurance solutions for homes, property, and related assets.
- [Travel Insurance](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/insurance): Travel-related insurance products for individuals.

## Small Business
- [Business Banking](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/s_m_business): Banking products and services for small businesses and entrepreneurs.
- [Business Accounts](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/s_m_business/open-accounts): Account opening and settlement services for businesses.
- [Acquiring](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/s_m_business/acquiring): Merchant acquiring and payment acceptance solutions.
- [Business Loans](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/s_m_business/credits): Financing and lending products for small businesses.
- [Payroll Projects](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/s_m_business/payroll): Payroll servicing solutions for employers and teams.
- [Business Cards](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/s_m_business/bank_cards): Card products for business spending and operations.

## Corporate Banking
- [Corporate Business](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/legal): Banking and financial services for corporate clients.
- [Settlement Services](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/legal/bankingservice): Cash management and settlement banking for companies.
- [Corporate Financing](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/legal/credits): Lending and financing solutions for legal entities.
- [Trade Finance](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/legal/tradefinance): Trade finance instruments and support for corporate transactions.
- [Deposits for Business](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/legal/deposits): Deposit and liquidity placement products for companies.
- [Foreign Economic Activity](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/legal/ved): Services supporting international and cross-border business operations.

## Support and Service
- [Help and Support](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/help): Customer help resources for retail banking services.

- [Service Tariffs](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/tariffs): Tariffs, fees, and service pricing information for individuals.
- [Security](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/dist_services): Guidance on secure use of banking channels and services.
- [Contacts](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/person/help): Contact and support access points for customers.

- [Press Center](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/press_center): News, announcements, and media materials from Sberbank.
